headline: Cal State LA move out of reach at the top
dek: Cal State LA have gone sixteen matches without a defeat, and no side can now reach their points before the conference season closes. A visit to Cal State Dominguez Hills is all that remains on their schedule.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Cal State LA have scored 29 goals, well short of the top of this chart, and have conceded four in sixteen matches without a defeat: the leaders' record is built on what they keep out, not what they put in.

wire.line: Cal State Monterey Bay have won every match they have played in October, the visit to Cal State San Bernardino among them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ten matches have passed their date with no result recorded; the latest, and the only one between conference sides, is Cal Poly Pomona's home match with Fresno Pacific.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded 50 goals in seventeen matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Stanislaus State have drawn seven of their seventeen matches, more draws than any other side in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cisco Avila has scored eleven of the 37 goals Cal State San Marcos have scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Yoel Vazquez has kept five shutouts in goal for Cal State San Marcos.

last_match.line: The win left Cal State LA beyond reach at the top of the table; Fresno Pacific have also lost to Cal State Monterey Bay, Cal State San Bernardino and Cal State San Marcos.

next_match.line: Cal State LA have not conceded since Cal State San Marcos scored against them, and have yet to lose all season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
